newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul won/dollar market closed, reopening Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Seoul won/dollar market closed, reopening Thursday.

text.p: Seoul's won/dollar market is closed on Wednesday for Buddha's Birthday. It will reopen on Thursday.
The won ended Tuesday down versus the dollar, pressured by active dollar short-covering by banks betting on the dollar's rise against the Japanese yen in world markets, traders said.
The won closed at 893.00 against Monday's closing of 891.70. It traded in a range of 892.10 to 893.70.
